target.title: fix(infra): widen gateway bind address loopback classification to full 127/8
target.body:
## What

Changed `classifyLoopbackAddressFamily` in the ports formatter from exact `"127.0.0.1"` match to `startsWith("127.")`, covering the full 127.0.0.0/8 loopback range. Also fixed the IPv4-mapped IPv6 path (`::ffff:127.x.x.x`) to use the same range check.

## Why

This function is used by `isExpectedGatewayBindAddress` and `isSingleExpectedGatewayListener` to classify gateway listeners. A gateway bound to `127.0.0.2` would return `null` from this function, causing potential false positives in gateway state detection (e.g., detecting an extra listener when multiplexed across multiple loopback addresses).

## Evidence

- Affected file: `src/infra/ports-format.ts`, `classifyLoopbackAddressFamily`
- The canonical `isLoopbackIpAddress` in `packages/net-policy/src/ip.ts` covers the full 127/8 range
- The `host.startsWith("127.")` pattern is already used correctly elsewhere (e.g., `src/gateway/model-pricing-cache.ts:812`)
